text.en: Claude Code 2.1.330, dated 20 November 2026, applies an organization's settings and its cloud provider or gateway after sign-in to Enterprise Admin Console organizations, according to its changelog.
text.es: Claude Code 2.1.330, del 20 de noviembre de 2026, aplica la configuración de la organización y su proveedor de nube o pasarela tras iniciar sesión en organizaciones de Enterprise Admin Console, según su changelog.
text.ca: Claude Code 2.1.330, del 20 de novembre de 2026, aplica la configuració de l'organització i el seu proveïdor de núvol o passarel·la després d'iniciar sessió a organitzacions d'Enterprise Admin Console, segons el seu changelog.

text.en: Google Antigravity App v2.34.0, dated 20 November 2026, adds MCP App support and stops sending configured MCP headers across cross-origin redirects, according to its changelog.
text.es: Google Antigravity App v2.34.0, del 20 de noviembre de 2026, añade soporte para MCP Apps y deja de enviar las cabeceras MCP configuradas en redirecciones a otro origen, según su changelog.
text.ca: Google Antigravity App v2.34.0, del 20 de novembre de 2026, afegeix suport per a MCP Apps i deixa d'enviar les capçaleres MCP configurades en redireccions a un altre origen, segons el seu changelog.

text.en: Claude desktop release notes of 20 November 2026 put computer use, which sees the screen and works in allowed desktop apps, in beta for Team and Enterprise plans.
text.es: Las notas de versión de Claude desktop del 20 de noviembre de 2026 ponen en beta para los planes Team y Enterprise el uso del ordenador, que ve la pantalla y trabaja en las aplicaciones de escritorio permitidas.
text.ca: Les notes de versió de Claude desktop del 20 de novembre de 2026 posen en beta per als plans Team i Enterprise l'ús de l'ordinador, que veu la pantalla i treballa a les aplicacions d'escriptori permeses.

text.en: CVE-2026-114494, CVE-2026-114495, CVE-2026-114496, CVE-2026-114497 and CVE-2026-114499, in NVD on 20 November 2026: codebase-memory-mcp flaws fixed in versions 0.9.0 to 0.10.0, according to NVD.
text.es: CVE-2026-114494, CVE-2026-114495, CVE-2026-114496, CVE-2026-114497 y CVE-2026-114499, en NVD el 20 de noviembre de 2026: fallos de codebase-memory-mcp corregidos en las versiones 0.9.0 a 0.10.0, según NVD.
text.ca: CVE-2026-114494, CVE-2026-114495, CVE-2026-114496, CVE-2026-114497 i CVE-2026-114499, a NVD el 20 de novembre de 2026: errors de codebase-memory-mcp corregits a les versions 0.9.0 a 0.10.0, segons NVD.

text.en: CVE-2026-77349, CVE-2026-77350, CVE-2026-77389 and CVE-2026-77390, in NVD on 20 November 2026: pmo-platform for Claude Code before 3.73 has hook and viewer flaws, according to NVD.
text.es: CVE-2026-77349, CVE-2026-77350, CVE-2026-77389 y CVE-2026-77390, en NVD el 20 de noviembre de 2026: pmo-platform para Claude Code anterior a 3.73 tiene fallos en sus hooks y en su visor, según NVD.
text.ca: CVE-2026-77349, CVE-2026-77350, CVE-2026-77389 i CVE-2026-77390, a NVD el 20 de novembre de 2026: pmo-platform per a Claude Code anterior a 3.73 té errors als seus hooks i al seu visor, segons NVD.

held.text_en: Kiro, dated 20 November 2026, offers the Enterprise Management preview in Europe (Frankfurt), where newly created Kiro profiles have Controls on from the start, according to its changelog.
Devin's release notes of 20 November 2026 add Access and Sharing changes, rolling out gradually and off by default, including an SCM access mismatch report for admins.
Muse Code 1.4.24, dated 21 November 2026, turns the skill and verify reminders off by default, according to its changelog.
Qoder CN CLI 1.1.94, dated 20 November 2026, runs subagents in the background by default and limits background Bash commands to 10 minutes by default, according to its changelog.
Orca v1.4.268, dated 21 November 2026, lets bots run on Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Hermes, according to its release notes.
Kilo Code v7.8.32, dated 20 November 2026, stops held keys and repeated close commands from confirming worktree deletion in Agent Manager, according to its release notes.
Devin Desktop v3.14.30833, dated 20 November 2026, fixes withdrawn tool approval prompts leaving remote SSH sessions on Waiting for approval, according to its changelog.
CVE-2026-77329, in NVD on 20 November 2026: the Tapo MCP server from 0.3.1 until 0.5.0 lacks Host and Origin validation, allowing DNS rebinding without an API key, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-77383 and CVE-2026-129995, in NVD on 20 November 2026: mcp-ssh-manager before 3.8.5 builds shell commands from caller-controlled values, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-130901, in NVD on 20 November 2026: awslabs.document-loader-mcp-server 1.0.10 through 1.0.20 can read files outside its base directory when it is unset, according to NVD.
Kiro Crew 0.13.0, dated 19 November 2026, turns on conductor mode, formerly Ultra Mode, in every standard build, according to its changelog.
Google Antigravity 2.8.0, dated 19 November 2026, adds custom certificate and proxy support during sign-in and recurring background update checks, according to its changelog.
OpenAI Codex rust-v0.171.0, dated 19 November 2026, adds codex exec --remote to start or resume noninteractive sessions on an existing app server, according to its release notes.
GHSA-4rj4-rcrq-gr92, in OSV on 19 November 2026: Safari MCP does not escape backslashes in single-quoted tool arguments, allowing JavaScript injection, according to OSV.
GHSA-mx6p-3fg7-v6pj, in OSV on 19 November 2026: obsidian-sync-mcp in no-auth mode lacks Host and Origin validation, allowing DNS rebinding, according to OSV.
GHSA-833v-v58w-294h, in OSV on 19 November 2026: the Todoist MCP server can be driven by websites through browser DNS rebinding, according to OSV.
GHSA-r7wg-f7r2-8wf7, in OSV on 19 November 2026: axon-mcp downloads code without an integrity check, according to OSV.
CVE-2026-77314, in NVD on 19 November 2026: Flyto2 Core before 2.26.8 lets the MCP run_recipe tool load workflows outside the recipe directory, according to NVD.
